model.summary: Model favors ATL by 4.1 points (67% win chance). Biggest factors: Quarterback rating (ATL +2.8), Elo rating (CHI +1.3), Scoring margin (season blend) (CHI +0.5). The baseline of +1.9 covers typical home-field advantage.

total_model.summary: Model projects 44.4 total points (ATL 24, CHI 20). Biggest factors: Combined quarterback ratings (lowers total 1.3), Wind x pass rate (lowers total 0.9), Natural grass field (raises total 0.7). The baseline of 45.7 is the typical NFL total in the training data.
